svg.aria-label: What wsl-shrinker reads: WSL's own answers, the disk files and the sizes inside a running distribution. It runs as you, with no administrator rights and no network. What it changes: a disk, only through Windows; inside a distribution, only what you chose and its containers; its own files. Nothing changes before you confirm.
